items.description: Here any one can develop voice apps for Amazon Echo, Google Assistant and Microsoft Cortana. We support proactive event notifications using scheduler and web hooks. Users can also develop Chatbots using NLP.

World news streaming TV mashup with Google Maps. Watch live world news TV from various TV channels like CNN, BBC, Sky News, ABC News Now, CCTV-9 China, Iran PressTV, France24, CNN IBN India, and Russia Today. Windows Media player required.

Environmental Working Groups interactive website and database makes it possible to see satellite images of the physical impacts of mining. The images show not only the impacts of existing mines, but where mining may occur in the future.
Send a Voice Message or SMS to your friends when you run out of money. Let them call you back!
Microsite that uses DonorsChoose API to show school programs where you can donate and where SONIC Drive-In has contributed.
Mashing up the Google Feed API and Windows Live Search for isfeed: access to RSS files, this provides a river of news reading experience for recent posts around any keyword.
Just Remind It is an iPhone application to send call-based voice reminders to yourself, friends, colleagues and clients. Send automatic reminders and get your tasks done.
Users can Dub any YouTube video with the sound of the other video, classify them as funny, sad, action etc. View user videos and then share their creations with friends. More uses onsite.
Search, watch and download any YouTube video.
Zvents allows users to discover events by location and type. For active event locations, Zvents leverages the Active.com API.
Google Picasa image search, in Turkish language. Uses GoogleAjaxFeeds to show latest searches.
